bundle.shortDescription: E2EE group location and chat, no server
bundle.longDescription: A serverless end-to-end encrypted group app. Location, chat, and file sharing are encrypted on-device with XChaCha20-Poly1305 and Ed25519 before being stored. GitHub is used only as an untrusted ciphertext store.
